Commentary.Commentary: Right, then! 2 matches, 2 wins and the series is Afghanistan's. Can Ireland avoid a whitewash? First they need to start picking the spinners from the opposition to do that. Join us for the third T20I on Friday, 24th August, 2018 at 1600 local (1500 GMT). ADIOS! TAKE CARE!

Afghanistan skipper, Asghar Afghan, thanks the Almighty for winning the series. Reckons they thought anything over 140 would have been a good score as they have quality bowlers. Feels they lost wickets in the middle which was the problem, otherwise they would have got a big score after the start Hazratullah Zazai gave them. Ends by saying that they will try for the whitewash come the final game.

Ireland skipper, Gary Wilson, says whenever you lose a game by such a big margin it's always disappointing. Feels the boys will be hurting as they will know it's not good enough, but everyone will train hard and try to come back well in the final game. Mentions that whenever you lose by a margin of 81 runs, the toss has no bearing on it.

It is not like there were no positives for Ireland at all. They started well with the ball and finished decently too, picking up 6 wickets in the last 5 overs - but that 116-run stand between Zazai and Afghan took the game away. Rankin's 2/14 and Dockrell's 1/19 in addition to Chase's 3-fer were the highlights for the home side. Stay tuned for the presentation.

As expected, spin was supposed to be the weak link for the Irish and that indeed turned out to be. Paul Stirling departed to Aftab but then Mujeeb got stuck into them. There was a brief fight between Porterfield and Wilson but once that was broken, it was all over. Just to emphasize on the spinners' stats - 10-0-53-8 - the combined figures of Mujeeb, Rashid and Nabi. Simply too good.

So Afghanistan register their 7th successive win over Ireland in this format. They have been unbeaten since 14th January 2017 and the Irish don't seem to be getting any closer to beating them. The hosts did well with the ball but floundered hopelessly with the bat.

William Porterfield is caught on the sidelines for a little chat. He says after a losing a couple of early wickets it's always difficult. Mentions they needed to get that one big partnership but it never came. Credits Mujeeb Ur Rahman and Rashid Khan for their splendid bowling as they made it difficult for the batsmen with their variations. States that they came close the other day, so it's just a bad day and anything can happen, so just have to come back fresh for the final game and give it their best.

OUT! Fantastic catch and that ends the game! Game and series to Afghanistan, with one more match to go. Floated outside off, Chase gets down and attempts a mighty slog sweep. Seems to have connected well but when he looks up, he sees Mohammad Nabi swooping onto his sweep from long on and taking a fantastic diving catch. AN 81-RUN WIN FOR AFGHANISTAN!!!
FOUR! Lucky boundary. Full and outside off, Chase has a wild slog but only gets a top edge. It flies over the keeper and eludes short fine leg to the fence behind.
The batsman was beaten and missed the line of the delivery.
Peter Chase is the last man in.
OUT! All the cheers have vanished now. The googly, around middle, Rankin plays all over it and misses the ball. Castled, is he.

SIX! THUMP! Something for the crowd to cheer. Hitting the best bowler from the opposition for a biggie. Flighted outside off, Rankin picks the leggie and deposits the leg spinner with a mow over mid-wicket!

LBW appeal, turned down again. PITCHED OUTSIDE LEG. That settles the argument. Rankin looks to flick but misses and is hit on the pads. Impact is outside leg while the ball seemed to be going past the leg stump too.
Full and outside off, Joshua looks to sweep but misses. Mujeeb finishes with figures of 4-0-17-3. Brilliant.
This one spits off the deck, darts in from outside off, Little plays all around it and is hit on the pads. An LBW appeal ensues but that was too high. Not the octane, but the impact.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
Boyd Rankin to try and save some face now... Ireland's lowest T20I score against Afghanistan is 71. Just saying...

OUT! Wickets are falling like ninepins here. Short and outside off, there to be hit and Dockrell hits it too. Pulls it but the shot goes straight to mid-wicket where Shenwari completes the formalities with a leap. Boy, Ireland could get bowled out here, well before the 20th over.
Full and around off, flicked straight to mid-wicket.
Mujeeb Ur Rahman is back on. 3-0-16-2 so far.
Driven through mid off by the batsman. They pick up a single. 12 balls, 2 wickets, 7 runs - the masterly miser.
The leg spinner now, flicked towards mid-wicket for a single.
Joshua Little is the new man in. Ireland might not do with a little score from him though...

OUT! Googled by the googly! Just too good for the batsman. Rashid comes running and bowls a wrong 'un and it is simply not picked by the batsman. The experienced skipper has a wild slog across the line, only to miss.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Full and outside off again, pushed towards mid off now.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover.
Rashid Khan is back on. 1-0-4-1 so far.
Tossed up outside off, driven back to the bowler. Just a run and a wicket from the over.
Full and around off, pushed back to the bowler.
The batsman plays a pull shot to this short delivery. They pick up a single.
Ireland staring down the barrel as they are now into their bowlers. George Dockrell is the first of them.

OUT! The leg stump is out of the ground! Going from bad to worse now. Simi Singh walks a mile across his stumps in his attempt to paddle but his indication is way too early. Nabi sees and slows his pace ever so much that Simi misses it completely. Well, not completely. The ball hits his gloves and then uproots the leg stump.
Full and around off, Simi looks to turn it to the leg side but the bat turns in his hands instead. A leading edge is induced which goes wide of the bowler.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.

Short and outside off, Gary cuts it hard behind point again and once more Mujeeb is the man chasing. This time he parries the ball towards deep backward point and the couple is completed with ease. The bowling change has done the trick...
A short ball outside off, Gary looks to cut but is beaten by the extra bounce.

SAFE! Lousy has the eyes of a hawk. It was a tricky call but the master called it right just when the umpire made the signal towards the third umpire. A short ball, Wilson cuts it hard behind point. Mujeeb Ur Rahman gets to the ball from third man and returns a good throw as the batsmen take the second. It is right over the bails as Wilson puts in a desperate dive. Replays are touch and go and eventually, the third umpire gives the benefit of the doubt to the batsman as when the bails are dislodged, the bat seemed to be slightly in the air, but not quite clear.
Run out? My colleague Lousy here feels Wilson has made it. What does the third umpire think?
A length ball this time, around middle, cutting back in sharply, Wilson looks to tuck it to the leg side but gets a thick inside edge onto his pads.
Simi Singh walks in at number 7, replacing O'Brien.

OUT! Kevin O'Brien perishes and that is half the side done and dusted. A short ball outside off, KOB possibly thought he had a chance to get on with the scoring rate and went for the pull. However, for him, the ball took the toe end and lobbed high in the end. Deep mid-wicket comes rushing in and takes it easily. Usman Ghani, the substitute, is the fielder.

Just over! A length ball to start the new spell, Wilson charges down the track and looks to pull it away. Miscues and luckily for him, the edge just about clears the man running back from short mid-wicket. Just a single.
Fareed Ahmad back on.

In the air but it's safe. Shorter in length, Wilson positions himself for the reverse sweep and top edges it. It balloons over point and falls well short of the fielder running in from the deep to catch it. Just the one and that will be the end of the over. 102 needed in 60 to win for Ireland.
Quicker in pace, attacking the stumps, it's flicked neatly through the vacant mid-wicket area for a brace.
Steps out of the crease again, but only presents a defensive shot in response on this occasion.
SIX! Nabi floats it up a little and this time Wilson dispatches it. Makes great use of his feet to get close to the pitch and smokes it over long on for half a dozen.
Big shout from Nabi but no can do, says the umpire. Wilson is too far out of the crease and it's going down leg too. Short again, Gary looks to work it across the line but misses.
Quick, short and on the stumps, O'Brien uses the depth of the crease to go back and whip it in front of square leg. One run collected.
Moves inside the line, brings his wrists into play before turning it through square leg. One run to end the over.
The batsman works it down the leg side. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Short and flat outside off, Kevin goes back and works it towards mid on for a single to get off the mark.
Could have been gone there. That was close. Full and fast, just outside off, O'Brien can't bring his bat down in time. He knows he's escaped one here, a little to the right and he was out of here.
Kevin O'Brien is in next. A lot rests on his shoulders now.

OUT! That's a superb catch! Well done, Aftab Alam. Porterfield gets low and brings out the reverse sweep. Doesn't middle it at all and it lobs towards short third man. Alam there moves to his right and takes a low diving catch. William was looking in fine touch, he departs at the wrong time for the Irish.
Loopy and full just outside off, swept through square leg for a single.
Rashid Khan into the bowling attack. His spell could swing the match in either team's favour, depending on how he does.
SIX! Much-needed for the home side, especially after a tight over. Short in line of the stumps, Porterfield camps back and muscles the pull high and handsome over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
Stays on the back foot and punches it to extra cover.
Darts it full and keeps it just outside off, William tries to bring his bat down to jam it out but misses. Good for him it wasn't in line of the stumps.
The batsman has played the reverse sweep. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Flat, quick and short outside off, cut through towards sweeper cover for a single.

Faster one outside off, Porterfield smashes it towards Shenwari at extra cover. An awkward bounce and the ball hits him on the left leg. That must have stung, he's down on the ground. The physio is out with the magic spray.
Mohammad Nabi to roll his arm over.
Shortens the length a touch this time, Porterfield gets an inside edge as he's cramped for room. The ball goes off the pads and rolls on the off side for a single.
Ireland have some momentum on their side now. Need to capitalize on that and get a move on.
FOUR! Two in two. Just what the hosts would have wanted. Some quick runs. Down the leg side and William puts it away through backward square leg.
FOUR! Welcome boundary for Ireland. Back of a length with some room on offer outside off, Porterfield pounces on it and puts it away with a fierce cut through the covers. No stopping that.
Stays back to the length ball and punches it just wide of mid off. The fielder there tries to stop it with a dive but can only make a half-stop. Two to the total.
Served on a length on a fifth stump channel, the Irish captain cuts this towards Rashid Khan at sweeper cover. He jogs over to the other end and completes a run.
Spears this full and keeps it just around off, it tails in slightly, Wilson looks to drive but gets an inside edge back down the track.
Straighter one on the pads, Gary nudges it to short fine leg. Takes the fielder on and beats his throw at the bowler's end. Single completed.
Square of the wicket again, another cut shot. One more run results.
Cuts this short ball just wide of point and gets a run for doing so.
Flatter and quicker, on the stumps, worked away into the gap on the leg side for a single.
Stays back and keeps it out off the back foot.

SIX! Nicely executed shot from William Porterfield. Full on off stump, the left-hander gets low, brings out the reverse sweep and connects well. It flies and goes flat over the deep backward point boundary for a maximum.
Mujeeb Ur Rahman called back on to have a go with the ball.
Short of a length outside off, some room on offer, Wilson cuts it hard but straight to backward point.
Fullish in length, outside the line of off stump, driven to the man at cover.

Dropped! Shahzad puts down a dolly. Oh, dear. How can you miss that? The simplest of catches really. Angling across on a length, outside off, Wilson plays away from his body and gets a feather behind. Shahzad can't keep a hold of a straightforward catch. Ahmad clearly frustrated with that.
Lofts this down towards long on and changes ends.
Good length delivery outside off, a play and a miss from the batsman.

Another sharp run. Gary Wilson works this in front of square leg and takes off. Asghar Afghan gets to the ball, has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. Wouldn't have mattered either, as his counterpart was well in by then.
Fareed Ahmad is brought into the attack.

Good running, this. Yorker fired in, Wilson digs it out towards mid on and quickly calls for the run. His partner responds and both batsmen cross over before the fielder can get to the ball. Nicely done.
In the channel outside off, on a good length, left alone.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

Loud shout for a leg before, but height has saved him. Possibly an inside edge too? No, just the height, then. Just behind a length on middle and off, slight movement inward, Wilson is rapped high on the thigh pad as he's beaten.
Goes full again, outside off this time, Porterfield drives it through the cover region for one run.
Full and tailing back in, flicked off the pads through square leg for a couple of runs.
Gary Wilson, the skipper, walks into the middle next. Ireland in trouble here.

OUT! Second of the over and third one down for the Irish. Mujeeb has done a superb job here. Slows this one up after darting a few in, as a result Balbirnie is done in. He's beaten in the flight so when he prods forward to push it, he chips it back towards the bowler. Mujeeb moves to his right and takes a tumbling catch.
The batsman plays a pull shot to this short delivery. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Shortish in length, around leg, pulled through square leg for a single.
Loopy from the offie, Porterfield presents a straight bat in defense.
Andy Balbirnie is the next man in to bat.

OUT! Afghanistan have their second wicket. Well, well, well... things have got quite interesting now. Length ball to which Thompson walks out to. Tries to go across the line but gets a big leading edge which pops back down the ground. Nabi at long off comes under it and makes no mistake in taking it.
Streaky runs. Skidding off the surface a bit, a length delivery on the stumps, it goes off the edge of the batsman's bat and runs down to fine leg for one.

Off the mark with that. Fraction straight in line, touch fuller too, Porterfield flicks it aerially through backward square leg. There is a man in the deep who moves to his right and cuts it off. Only a single taken.
William Porterfield walks in at no.3.

OUT! Big blow for Ireland. The dangerous Paul Stirling departs without doing any damage. Good bowling from Alam. He bowls it full and makes it come back in, Stirling flicks it aerially towards Rashid Khan at mid-wicket. He's at the edge of the circle. Moves to his right and takes it safely.
Wide! Down the leg side and that's a wide.
Short. Got to be careful here. Stirling has width on offer so he flashes at it. Cuts it in front of gully.

Ooooohh! That's come in a long way! Seaming back in heavily from a good length, on middle, Stirling looks to cut and almost pays the price for it. The ball, luckily for him, takes the inside edge and raps him on the pads.

Big top edge but Thompson is safe. Back of a length around off, the southpaw throws his bat at it with a big swing but manages a big top edge which flies towards third man. Well short of the fielder though and a single is taken.
Lands it on a good length just around off, it shapes away, Thompson tries to feel for it but gets beaten past the outside edge.
Aftab Alam to bowl from the other end.
Knocked through to long on for a run to end the over. Decent start for the hosts.
Goes deep inside the crease, it's on a flatter trajectory, turned in front of square leg for one.
Leans ahead to this fullish ball and drives it to long on for a single.
Plays the same shot, connects on this occasion. Straight to short third man though.
Landed outside off from around the wicket, Thompson tries to play the reverse sweep but wears it on the front pad.
Ireland's account is opened straightaway. Full and quick on the stumps, Stirling kneels down and sweeps it just wide of short fine leg for a single.

We are back for the run chase. 161 to win and Ireland are favourites to win at the moment. Though, all that can change with a couple of early wickets. Paul Stirling and Stuart Thompson will open for the home side, while Mujeeb Ur Rahman will take the ball first up. Here we go...
